title: Central simple algebras and continuous Galois degree-two classes
statement: For every field K, its set of Brauer equivalence classes of finite-dimensional central simple K-algebras is in bijection with H²_G(Ks^×) [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology].

source.place: Theorem 03R7, its scalar-defect construction following Lemma 03R6, and Section 0DVG

proof.text: The upstream existsUnique_hasBrauerScalarDefect applies Algebra.IsCentral.exists_algEquiv_matrix_of_isSepClosed to obtain a positive matrix splitting, then exists_brauerScalarDefect_lifts to obtain matrix lifts and a cycle. Its homology class satisfies HasBrauerScalarDefect. Faithfulness with A=B proves uniqueness. brauerScalarDefectClass chooses this uniquely determined class.

The upstream brauerScalarDefectClass_eq_iff uses faithfulness to show that the class map respects Brauer equivalence and detects it. Quotient.lift descends the map to BrauerGroup. Quotient.inductionOn₂ and Quotient.sound establish injectivity.

The upstream exists_csa_brauerScalarDefect supplies an algebra realizing each class. eq_brauerScalarDefectClass_iff identifies its chosen class with that class and gives a quotient preimage. Equiv.ofBijective packages the map as brauerGroupEquivGaloisUnitsH2. This concrete equivalence realizes the node directly and implies the retired Nonempty theorem.

proof_origin.place: The scalar-defect construction following Lemma 03R6, Theorem 03R7, and Section 0DVG
